svg.text: What lies behind the play: a far wash, stars in three depths, one landmark, the sector's air and a vignette, in each sector's own look and each palette's own colors. Drawn by
art/sheets/sectors.mjs from art/lib/backdrop.mjs; nothing is traced or copied.
1. The four places, in Casino night
A laptop's field, 72 by 40 units at 10 px a unit, each with a dozen rocks of its sector's kinds and a burst of shots. The rocks and the shots should be the first things seen.
Inner belt: a ringed planet's limb low on the right, in a warm, calm wash
Iron reach: a cratered moon in a broken girder ring, in cold steel with dark pools
Storm: a thunderhead up the left side with forks inside it, wind across an ember wash
Endless: a galaxy's band from corner to corner, the wave's constellation over it
The same fields at 5 px a unit. In a light palette space is white: the wash is a pale tint, the stars are dark specks, and a landmark is paper left dry in the wash, its shade in pale ink.
A tall field, 40 by 72 units at 6 px a unit. A landmark keeps its size and its corner, so the short side shows more of it; the wash stretches the way the field is long.

Storm at 5 px a unit, back to front: the far wash, the stars in three depths, the landmark, the air and the vignette, each alone, then all five together, the landmark as a fork flickers, a third of a second
every eleven or so, and the whole under the play.
Casino night: the landmark at a flicker
Classic felt: the landmark at a flicker

Every color turned to the grey as light as it is, at 4 px a unit, beside today's flat field. Under each: the most any large shape of that backdrop stands out from the field, which the direction holds under
Today's backdrop, the field's flat color under specks of one size, beside the Inner belt's, with the same rocks on both.
